name: claudeconnect
notes: Settings change the moment you change them. There's no Save button anymore: a switch, a new logo, or a new name (when you press Enter or click away) takes effect straight away, on every device, without redeploying the site.
Everything the edit command can change is in Settings, and more: under General → This computer you can also choose which of Claude Code's chats the sidebar lists, and the folder Claude Code works in.
Right after an update, the site no longer says "Update available" for the version you just installed.
